source: correlated assistant message textContent/raw text only

frame.location_rule: markers are located by their random tokens; surrounding punctuation is ignored so markdown/HTML rendering cannot erase a marker (v2.2.3 used <<<...>>>, which sanitizers can strip as an HTML tag)
frame.outside_frame_text: ignored for semantic parsing but preserved in RAW; any second matching frame is ambiguity failure

interior_modes.accept_if: trim(frame interior) parses as exactly one JSON object
frame interior contains exactly one fenced code block whose text parses as exactly one JSON object and no other parseable JSON object exists outside it

no fence markers survived rendering and exactly one balanced top-level {...} span parses as a JSON object; rendered code-block chrome such as a language label or "Copy code" is ignored as wrapper text

reject_if: more than one parseable JSON object
canonical_output: parsed JSON object only; wrapper prose/fences never enter CANONICAL representation
raw_output: full correlated assistant text is retained unchanged for audit
deterministic_json_repairs: raw control characters inside JSON string literals are escaped (lossless); no other repair is applied
